rationale: C03 plausibly supplied a concrete letter template. Both are replies to Senator Flanders concerning a jointly signed congressional communication; both open by acknowledging that communication and welcoming the signers’ support, then review an ongoing international program, explain obstacles and current governmental efforts, and close by seeking continued congressional support. The repeated addressee-specific framing and parallel argumentative sequence are materially more distinctive than a shared foreign-policy topic. C11 and C20 share some United Nations/free-world and peace-and-defense exposition, but not the same correspondence machinery or overall structure.

shared_material.parent_excerpt: I have studied with interest the letter of August eighteenth, signed by you and 27 other Senators... It is gratifying to have this expression of support
shared_material.explanation: Distinctively parallel acknowledgment of a jointly signed communication from Senator Flanders, immediately treating it as useful support for an international-policy initiative.

shared_material.explanation: Both pivot from the acknowledgment into an extended review of the administration’s prior efforts and the development of the relevant program.
